I need to create a line mechanism connecting two points: point 1 at (10, 1) and point 2 at (3, 11). The plan is to output a diagonal trail from (10, 2) upward-right, until reaching row 4, columns 7-10. Then, I want the line to go horizontally to column 10, near point 2. I’m using slope to guide the path and will demonstrate this line in a test. It seems like an L-shape connection would work nicely!**Creating a path calculation**

I need to derive the path from point 1 to point 2. It seems I should use a staircase pattern, going diagonally and then horizontally. The vector from 1 to 2 is (-7, +10). I'll move diagonally up-right to (4, 7) in increments, then go horizontally to column 10, finishing right next to point 2.

 "content": "def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    pts = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(len(grid)) for c in range(len(grid[0])) if grid[r][c] in (1, 2)]
    a = next((p for p in pts if p[2] == 1), None)
    b = next((p for p in pts if p[2] == 2), None)
    if a is None or b is None:
        return out
    r, c = a[:2]
    tr, tc = b[:2]
    dr = 0 if tr == r else (1 if tr > r else -1)
    dc = 0 if tc == c else (1 if tc > c else -1)
    # Advance diagonally while both coordinates can still move toward the target,
    # leaving the final target-adjacent row/column unpainted.
    while (tr-r)*(dr) > 1 and (tc-c)*(dc) > 1:
        r += dr
        c += dc
        if (r, c) != (tr, tc) and out[r][c] == 0:
            out[r][c] = 3
    # Complete the remaining axis-aligned segment, stopping adjacent to color 2.
    while dr and r + dr != tr and c == tc:
        r += dr
        if out[r][c] == 0: out[r][c] = 3
    while dc and c + dc != tc and r == tr:
        c += dc
        if out[r][c] == 0: out[r][c] = 3
    # If diagonal segment stopped short along only one axis, finish along that axis.
    if r != tr - dr and c == tc - dc:
        while r != tr - dr:
            r += dr
            if out[r][c] == 0: out[r][c] = 3
    elif c != tc - dc and r == tr - dr:
        while c != tc - dc:
            c += dc
            if out[r][c] == 0: out[r][c] = 3
    return out
"
